column1: # B1059 glyph atlas 'titanium': one row per distinct glyph bitmap, built by
# `oracle_glyphs.py build` from labelled crops (truth_source: the log/plan/pcap/
# DB/XML side the label came from, never the image); source + glyph_rect cite
# the frame pixels each bitmap was cut from. Built from rigs: lane1,lane3,lane4,lane5,devu24.
# text 'a|b' = identical bitmaps of different characters (an ambiguous class);
# a multi-character text = touching glyphs (one cluster).
# ncc over the atlas: worst between bitmaps of one text 0.6383, best between different texts 1.0000
# font default: gap inside words max 3, between words min 4
# font edit: gap inside words max 2, between words min -
# font title: gap inside words max 1, between words min 5
